xmldoc.short_description: Read, write, create, and inspect netCDF data sources.

description.p: The netCDF module provides high-level file functions and low-level wrappers around the netCDF C library.
High-level functions use filenames and variable names. Low-level functions use numeric identifiers returned by netcdf.create, netcdf.open, netcdf.defDim, netcdf.defVar, and related calls.
Use high-level functions for everyday file I/O. Use low-level functions when exact control of groups, define mode, storage options, attributes, and user-defined types is required.
